title: Kite Base
description: The simplest base: fold two edges to a diagonal to make a kite. It is the starting point of the fish and bird bases.

steps.title: Fold corner to opposite corner: bring the bottom-right corner to the top-left corner
steps.text: Fold corner to opposite corner: bring the bottom-right corner to the top-left corner. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Kite fold: from the bottom-left corner, fold the bottom edge onto the diagonal
steps.text: Kite fold: from the bottom-left corner, fold the bottom edge onto the diagonal. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Kite fold: from the bottom-left corner, fold the left edge onto the diagonal
steps.text: Kite fold: from the bottom-left corner, fold the left edge onto the diagonal. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Collapse along the existing creases
steps.text: Collapse along the existing creases: re-fold every valley toward you and every mountain away from you at the same time, then flatten.
